facts.what: 揉眼再睁，女人仍在；她自问「是不是全在我脑子里」，结论是她太真
facts.anchor: What if it’s just all in my head? It can’t be. She’s too real.

facts.what: 靠近并把手放上 Finlay 的肩，只有 Cassie 惊跳，他毫无反应
facts.anchor: The figure steps closer, places a hand on his shoulder, but I’m the one who jumps at the touch. He doesn’t flinch.

facts.what: 说早知她已走，仍追问还能不能多知道什么
facts.anchor: ‘I knew it. I knew she was gone,’ he says blankly.

facts.what: 第一次开始相信自己；决定不全盘托出所见
facts.anchor: He believes me, and for the very first time, I’m starting to believe in myself, too.

facts.what: 起身要离开；她追到门口请求保持联系、可发短信
facts.anchor: ‘Finlay, wait. Maybe you could send me a text?

facts.what: 掏钱包亮出二十镑钞票问她该付多少
facts.anchor: he reaches his arm behind his back and pulls his wallet from his pocket.

facts.what: 拒绝收钱，觉得被当成性交易或廉价服务，自我厌恶到想放弃
临走说她不会让他难受、让她保重、也许有缘再见，并眨眼
facts.anchor: ‘I don’t think you could ever upset me. Look after yourself, OK? Maybe our paths will cross again someday.’

relations: Cassie 对 Finlay 产生强烈依恋；他付钱后离开；女形只被她看见
